{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured wool-blend blazer in charcoal grey (#2F323A) with sharp shoulders and a cropped waist length; fitted high-waisted trousers in black matte jersey with a straight-leg cut at ankle length.
Leather pumps in deep burgundy (#4A0E18) with a 7cm block heel.
Gold-tone hoop earrings in polished metal and a slim leather belt in black to define the waist.
This ensemble balances her request for classical registers with the energetic atmosphere of a rock concert through dark, structured tailoring that stands out against stage lights. The matte fabrics and sharp lines keep the look refined and restrained while allowing freedom of movement needed for standing in a crowd. Warm autumn tones in the burgundy heel add a subtle pop of color that complements her skin tone without overwhelming the classic aesthetic she desires."}
